Thanks very much for replying. I understand what you mean, I realized that you would also have to change the app to a var instead of a const if you did what i was suggesting. I was thinking of code reuse, but perhaps in this case its one line so its fine. It was my first time commenting on an open source project, so i really do appreciate your comment.

> change the app to a var instead of a const

actually, it could be a `let`. It's like a `var` but it's blocked scoped instead of function scoped (in line with how `const` works) :)
i just always though functional programming dictated making everything a constant or immutable. So i can make it a let and still be somewhat in line with how const works? thanks.
Yeah, although I would personally recommend staying functional and try to make everything `const` and immutable 👍
awesome, thanks for the explanation.

Express now follows `standard` formatting for all new work, so that would be no-semicolons on these lines.  To be clear, that does not mean apply it to all other lines, just the ones you are touching already.
I would just leave this off the pr since it's a style only change.
